vendors.name: Bopple
vendors.reason: AU/NZ restaurant/café online ordering with pick-up and scheduled pre-ordering; its pricing page has a '$ NZD' currency option, and the page's own code shows the same $49 for NZ (only US differs); NZD platform fee on its fees page

plans.note: The server HTML renders AUD by default; the NZD amount was confirmed from the pricing page's own script (https://www.bopple.com/_next/static/immutable/chunks/1clorhgaxbk9y.js, module 39826 'PricingClient'): 'let eW="US"===e$?"$29":"$49"' — so with '$ NZD' selected the plan shows '$49' + 'per month' (USD shows $29). Fee: 'Platform fee by region, from 1 October 2026 … New Zealand NZD 2.4% + $0.10' (/pricing/fees). Matches compare-research-1 (49 NZD + 2.4%).
